Compile rectangular ggtree branches for a ggexon tree panel

Source: R/geom-genetag.R
compile_ggtree_rectangular_segments.Rd

compile_ggtree_rectangular_segments() converts a rectangular ggtree plot or tree object into plain segment rows. The returned data can be drawn with ggplot2::geom_segment() inside ggexon() and aligned to a gene-tag panel with facet_genomics().

Usage

compile_ggtree_rectangular_segments(
  tree = NULL,
  tree_plot = NULL,
  layout = "rectangular",
  track = "Tree"
)

Arguments

tree

Optional tree object accepted by ggtree::ggtree().

tree_plot

Optional existing ggtree plot. If supplied, tree is ignored.

layout

ggtree layout. Currently only "rectangular" is supported.

track

Facet-track value assigned to all branch segments.

Value

A data.frame with track, x, xend, y, yend, node, parent, segment, isTip, and label columns.
